title.en: How ZeroWeb tests AI-autonomous software engineering
title.zh: ZeroWeb 如何验证 AI 自主软件工程

description.en: A browser gives AI development a long-running test case: architecture, code, debugging and verification must work together.
description.zh: 浏览器为 AI 开发提供了长期测试对象：架构、代码、故障排查和验证必须一起工作。

body.en:
What the experiment asks

ZeroWeb explores whether AI can keep a large systems project under development. A human sets direction, makes key decisions and verifies results; AI analyzes tasks, changes code, adds tests and investigates failures. The project is experimental and is not yet an everyday browser.

Why a browser?

A browser connects HTML parsing, CSS, layout, fonts, graphics, scripting, network requests and platform integration. A change that compiles can still break page behavior or rendering. These dependencies make it a useful test of sustained engineering rather than isolated code generation.

How changes are checked

The repository uses module boundaries, specifications, review rules and CI. Checks include unit and integration tests, Web Platform Tests, pixel comparisons and browser comparisons. The appropriate check depends on the changed behavior; one green test does not prove every browser path works.

What evidence to read

Read the development updates for completed work and remaining tasks, and the test results for measured trends. Updates link to commits and goal documents. Test results include corpus versions and measurement units, because changing the denominator can change the apparent pass rate.

What the results do not prove

Repository size and commit count describe activity, not software quality or human productivity saved. Closed goals record their scoped acceptance evidence; they do not imply complete web standards support or production readiness.

Sources: project README, quality gates, engineering rules.
body.zh:
实验要回答什么

ZeroWeb 检验 AI 能否持续推进一个大体量系统项目。人负责方向、关键决策和结果验证；AI 分析任务、修改代码、补充测试和排查失败。项目仍处于实验阶段，尚不能作为日常浏览器使用。

为什么选择浏览器

浏览器连接 HTML 解析、CSS、布局、字体、图形、脚本、网络请求和平台集成。改动即使能够编译，也可能破坏网页行为或渲染。这些依赖关系适合检验持续工程工作，而不只是单次代码生成。

如何检查改动

仓库通过模块边界、技术规范、评审规则和 CI 约束开发。检查包括单元测试、集成测试、Web Platform Tests、像素对比和浏览器对比。需要什么检查取决于改动的行为；一个测试通过不能证明所有浏览器路径都正常。

应该看哪些证据

开发进展记录已完成工作与剩余任务，测试结果展示测量趋势。更新链接到 commit 和目标文档。数据包含语料版本和计量单位，因为分母变化也会改变表面上的通过率。

结果不能证明什么

仓库大小和提交数描述活动量，不代表软件质量，也不能直接推算节省了多少人工。目标完成说明其限定范围内的验收结果，不意味着 Web 标准全部支持或产品已经可用于生产。

来源：项目 README、质量门禁、工程规则。

title.en: ZeroWeb Rust browser architecture: from request to pixels
title.zh: ZeroWeb Rust 浏览器架构：从请求到像素

description.en: Follow the page pipeline and the boundaries between the browser application, embeddable WebView, engine and rendering infrastructure.
description.zh: 沿页面管线了解浏览器应用、嵌入式 WebView、页面引擎和渲染基础设施之间的职责边界。

body.en:
Two product entrypoints

ZeroBrowser is the browser application. ZeroWebView is the embedding API for host applications. Both use the same project foundations, but desktop browser execution can cross process boundaries; an in-process demo alone does not validate that path.

The page pipeline

  1. net handles resources and navigation.
  2. dom parses HTML with html5ever, while css-parser parses style rules.
  3. style-system computes styles from matching rules, inheritance and the cascade.
  4. layout-engine produces geometry using Taffy and project layout logic.
  5. engine coordinates the page pipeline and painting; render-foundation supplies GPU/CPU primitives and font infrastructure.

Host and process boundaries

host-runtime handles platform windows and input. The browser application integrates product state with the WebView. protocol defines messages between process roles such as the browser and renderer. The shared page-runtime connects page execution to different hosts.

Where to start reading

Start at crates/webview/src/webview.rs for the public embedding surface, apps/browser/src/main.rs for the desktop host, or crates/engine/src/pipeline for page processing. Read the current source together with the architecture guide: module presence does not imply complete standards support.

Sources: architecture guide, WebView source, renderer source.
body.zh:
两个产品入口

ZeroBrowser 是浏览器应用，ZeroWebView 是供宿主应用使用的嵌入 API。两者复用项目基础设施，但桌面浏览器执行可能跨越进程边界，仅检查进程内演示不能验证这条路径。

页面管线

  1. net负责资源获取与导航。
  2. dom使用 html5ever 解析 HTML，css-parser解析样式规则。
  3. style-system通过规则匹配、继承与层叠生成计算样式。
  4. layout-engine结合 Taffy 与项目布局逻辑生成几何信息。
  5. engine协调页面管线与绘制，render-foundation提供 GPU/CPU 图元与字体基础设施。

宿主和进程边界

host-runtime处理平台窗口与输入。浏览器应用将产品状态与 WebView 集成。protocol定义浏览器、renderer 等进程角色之间的消息。共享的page-runtime把页面执行接入不同宿主。

从哪里开始阅读

嵌入 API 从crates/webview/src/webview.rs开始；桌面宿主从apps/browser/src/main.rs开始；页面处理从crates/engine/src/pipeline开始。阅读架构指南时应同时核对当前源码，模块存在不代表 Web 标准已经完整支持。

来源：架构指南、WebView 源码、renderer 源码。

title.en: Getting started with ZeroWebView and ZeroBrowser

description.en: Prepare a local checkout, launch the desktop browser and inspect the WebView API before embedding the experimental engine.
description.zh: 准备本地代码、启动桌面浏览器，并在嵌入实验性引擎前了解 WebView API 与演示的实际范围。

body.en:
Check prerequisites

  • Rust 1.85 or newer, with edition 2024 support.
  • Git, GNU Make and the platform build tools. Development and comparison scripts use Node.js 20 or newer.
  • macOS: Xcode Command Line Tools. Linux: install the desktop libraries listed in the development guide. Windows: use MSVC Build Tools and the documented libclang setup.

The commands below use the Linux/macOS entrypoints. Windows users should follow the linked Windows guide and its PowerShell scripts.

Prepare the repository

git clone https://github.com/leizongmin/ZeroWeb.git
cd ZeroWeb
make setup-rusty-v8

The setup command downloads the V8 archive matching the checked-out dependency version and Rust host target. It needs access to the release download; if it fails, inspect the target and download diagnostics before continuing.

Launch a real browser window

This entrypoint builds the browser and its companion process binaries, then opens a desktop browser window:

make browser

First-run compilation can take time. A build error means the window has not been launched; check platform prerequisites and V8 setup first. Successfully opening a window does not establish real-site compatibility or production readiness.

Inspect the smaller demo

cargo run --bin webview-demo

Expect a host window with static text rendered through the project's graphics infrastructure. This is not a complete example of every ZeroWebView page API. For embedding, inspect the public API and current configuration types in the WebView crate; the API surface is still evolving.

Plan host integration

Keep page capabilities behind the WebView API rather than coupling your application directly to layout or paint internals. Decide which script features and rendering backend your host needs, and validate navigation, input and lifecycle behavior in that actual configuration.

Sources: Linux/macOS setup, Windows setup, embedding API, demo source.
body.zh:
核对前置条件

  • Rust 1.85 或更新版本，支持 edition 2024。
  • Git、GNU Make 与平台编译工具。开发和浏览器对比脚本使用 Node.js 20 或更新版本。
  • macOS 安装 Xcode Command Line Tools；Linux 按开发指南安装桌面依赖；Windows 使用 MSVC Build Tools，并按文档配置 libclang。

下方命令使用 Linux/macOS 入口。Windows 请按文末的环境指南使用 PowerShell 脚本。

准备代码仓库

git clone https://github.com/leizongmin/ZeroWeb.git
cd ZeroWeb
make setup-rusty-v8

准备命令下载与当前依赖版本、Rust host target 匹配的 V8 预编译库，需要能访问 release 下载。失败时先检查 target 与下载诊断，再继续构建。

启动真实浏览器窗口

这个入口会先构建浏览器及配套进程二进制，再打开桌面浏览器窗口：

make browser

首次编译可能需要较长时间。若出现构建错误，窗口尚未启动，应先核对平台依赖和 V8 设置。窗口能够打开，不代表真实网站兼容性已经通过或产品适合生产使用。

检查更小的演示

cargo run --bin webview-demo

预期看到宿主窗口中的静态文本，由项目图形基础设施绘制。它不是覆盖所有 ZeroWebView 页面 API 的完整示例。嵌入时应查看 WebView crate 的公共 API 和当前配置类型，API 仍在演进。

规划宿主集成

通过 WebView API 接入页面能力，避免让应用直接依赖布局或绘制内部实现。明确宿主需要的脚本 feature 与渲染后端，并在实际配置下验证导航、输入和生命周期行为。

来源：Linux/macOS 环境、Windows 环境、嵌入 API、演示源码。

title.en: How to read ZeroWeb WPT and performance results
title.zh: 如何阅读 ZeroWeb 的 WPT 与性能结果

description.en: Understand self-source reftests, assertion-based suites, changing corpus sizes and p95 benchmarks before comparing results.
description.zh: 在比较结果前，先区分自身一致性像素测试、断言测试、变化的语料分母与 p95 性能基准。

body.en:
What WPT means

Web Platform Tests is a shared test suite for web platform behavior. ZeroWeb imports fixed snapshots and tracks selected suites. A tracked subset is not the complete upstream suite.

Self-source reftests

For the CSS rendering series, ZeroWeb renders both the test page and the reference page and compares their pixels. This measures self-consistency. Both pages can share the same defect and still match, so a pass alone does not prove Chrome-equivalent rendering.

Assertion-based suites and browser comparisons

Testharness suites report assertions about observable behavior. Separate Chrome comparisons inspect page output or interactions against another browser. These methods answer different questions and should not be merged into one compatibility percentage.

Keep the denominator

Always read passed / total, unit, corpus version and date together. A row counted in files differs from one counted in subtests. Planned suites have no measurement; they are not zero-score tests. The monthly rendering series takes the latest recorded result for each month, not an average.

Read performance within its conditions

The data page reports p95 values from the recorded benchmark series and identifies its runner class. Compare the same metric, unit and environment. A runner-class label alone cannot prove identical hardware or eliminate measurement noise. The page's newest data date can come from one suite while another chart remains older.

Inspect the published tables and their raw-data links. Sources: metrics generator, test runner, WPT documentation.
body.zh:
WPT 是什么

Web Platform Tests 是共同验证 Web 平台行为的测试集。ZeroWeb 导入固定快照，并跟踪选定测试集。跟踪的子集不能视为完整上游测试集。

自身一致性像素测试

CSS 渲染序列中，ZeroWeb 同时渲染测试页和参照页，再逐像素比较。这衡量自身一致性。如果两页存在同一个缺陷，仍可能匹配，因此通过不能单独证明与 Chrome 渲染一致。

断言测试与浏览器对比

testharness 测试集通过断言检查可观察行为。单独的 Chrome 对比则检查与另一浏览器的页面输出或交互差异。这些方法回答不同问题，不能合成一个兼容率。

保留分母

阅读数据时要同时看通过 / 总数、单位、语料版本与日期。以文件计数的行与以子测试计数的行不同。规划中的测试集尚无测量，不是得分为零。月度渲染序列取当月最后一次记录，不是月平均值。

在测量条件内看性能

数据页展示记录的性能序列 p95，并标明 Runner 类别。应比较同一指标、单位与环境。Runner 类别相同本身不能证明硬件完全相同或排除测量噪声。页面最新数据日期可能来自某个测试集，其他图表的数据仍然较旧。

查看公开数据表及原始数据链接。来源：指标生成器、测试 runner、WPT 文档。
